v2-1768923178594-5x2m1y17v.name: Aethelgard
v2-1768923178594-5x2m1y17v.description: A serene and dreamlike realm where gravity-defying cities float above tranquil, cerulean waters, bathed in perpetual bright daylight.

v2-1768923178594-wi31ko5ff.name: The Azure Expanse
v2-1768923178594-wi31ko5ff.description: A vast, tranquil body of blue-green water upon which the floating city of Aethelgard is built.

v2-1768923178594-s0n665hx7.name: The Celestial Citadel
v2-1768923178594-s0n665hx7.description: An intricately designed stack of buildings, crafted from light-colored stone and reddish-orange brickwork, with numerous domed roofs, arched windows, balconies, and tall towers, soaring above the azure waters. A curved stone bridge with patterned surface extends outwards, and two large, spherical, clear blue glass orbs filled with water are featured beneath an arch and on the bridge.

v2-1768923227983-026pi06aj.name: The Celestial Citadel
v2-1768923227983-026pi06aj.description: A magnificent complex of buildings constructed from pale stone and rich reddish-orange brick, characterized by numerous domed roofs, arched windows, balconies, and soaring towers, all situated above shimmering azure waters. A gracefully curved stone bridge with an intricate surface leads to its entrance.
forbiddenTransformations: The Citadel should not appear as a modern architectural style.
The Citadel's structures should not be made of materials other than stone and brick.
The surrounding water should not be depicted as murky or polluted.
The sky should not be overcast or stormy.
The Citadel should not appear weathered or dilapidated.
The spherical water orbs should remain a consistent visual element.

v2-1768923227983-fxg72o138.name: Citadel Antechamber
v2-1768923227983-fxg72o138.description: You have entered a grand antechamber within the Celestial Citadel. The space is carved from the citadel's light-colored stone, leading deeper into its heart. Intricate architectural details hint at the grandeur of the structure.
forbiddenTransformations: The antechamber should not have exposed brickwork as a primary interior material; it should be stone-focused.
The ceiling should not be open to the sky or appear as a simple flat surface.
No visible signs of wear and tear or decay on the stone surfaces.
The space should not contain furniture incongruous with the citadel's aesthetic (e.g., modern seating).
There should be no direct sunlight, only reflected or ambient light.
The space should not feel cramped or utilitarian; it must retain a sense of grandeur.

v2-1768923283043-34pnyj7e2.name: Tower Top Chamber
v2-1768923283043-34pnyj7e2.description: This is a high chamber within one of the citadel's towers, offering a breathtaking panoramic view of the Azure Expanse and the surrounding architecture. The space is bathed in the bright midday sun, highlighting the ornate details of its construction.
forbiddenTransformations: The view from the windows showing anything other than the Azure Expanse and the citadel's architecture
Any indication of a ceiling that is not domed or vaulted
The presence of modern technology or furniture
Visible signs of wear or damage to the stone or brickwork
The introduction of any metallic or industrial materials
A lighting scheme that does not originate from the arched windows
The space feeling cramped or enclosed despite its height
